faq.title: The essential answers about Histae.
faq.intro: Availability, how connections work, pricing and privacy: here is what to know before launch.

availability.question: When and where will Histae be available?
availability.answer: The iOS and Android app is in development. The initial launch is planned for France, with no confirmed public date yet. Official store links will be published on this website as soon as they open.

account.question: How will I create an account?
account.answer: Access is designed to be passwordless, using a one-time code sent by SMS. The initial launch supports French +33 phone numbers.

discovery.question: How are suggested profiles selected?
discovery.answer: Discovery checks age ranges, who each person is looking for and maximum distance in both directions. It uses a recent, consented location and excludes profiles already assessed, blocked or matched.

match.question: How does a match work?
match.answer: After two mutual likes, you can talk for 24 hours. Sending is then paused for a further 24 hours: history remains readable and each person can continue or end the match. Choices stay private until both agree, reopening the conversation. A decline or no mutual agreement within the deadline ends the match without naming who declined.

photos.question: Why are photos not visible immediately?
photos.answer: Histae puts the profile, personality and conversation first. Photos are revealed only after both people agree, independently from their decision to continue the match.

pricing.question: What is the difference between Free and Premium?
pricing.answer: Free receives {freeCredits} credits every Monday at 00:00 UTC, without rollover. An optional video earns 1 extra credit, with up to {advertisingStock} advertising credits retained across weeks. Each Free participant reserves 1 credit when choosing to continue; it is charged only after both agree. Declining or expiry releases reservations. Each Free participant can confirm at most {weeklyMaximum} continuations per week. Premium removes ads and this limit at {monthlyPrice} per month or {annualPrice} per year, with a planned {trialDays}-day trial.

location.question: How is location used and retained?
location.answer: Location is used only for discovery with separate consent, and the displayed distance is rounded. It becomes stale after one hour, is deleted after 24 hours without an update and disappears immediately when consent is withdrawn.

moderation.question: Can I block or report someone?
moderation.answer: Yes. Blocking cuts the connection, closes the related matches and prevents them from being recreated while the block remains active. A report can include its reason and, when relevant, the related match.

privacy.question: How can I exercise my rights or delete my data?
privacy.answer: Histae provides dedicated journeys for access, portability, correction, restriction, objection and erasure. The export gathers account data; deletion removes the main data, anonymises messages and closes matches.
